snippet.title: CHAPTER 3 Installment 1 Launch Trailer - LAMBDARUNE
snippet.description:
Gamejolt page: https://gamejolt.com/games/lambdarune/960010

Installment 1— Chapter 3 of Lambdarune is Set to Release This Valentine’s Day! Coinciding with the 3-year anniversary of Signal of Freedom’s initial launch.

Over the past six months, we’ve been hard at work creating Chapter 3 from the ground up.

Installment 1, which includes Foane’s new encounter, is now finalized.

Looking ahead, we’re aiming to complete Chapter 3 in the coming months with Installment 2, which will feature the final battles. Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned for more updates! ^^

Discord Server: https://discord.gg/caqQwEuWv3

⋆｡°✩Credits✩°｡⋆

Soundtrack:
- 'TV Jingle' by ZET
- 'On The Air!' by ZET: https://soundcloud.com/nova-co-lr/chapter-3-on-the-air

Video Editing:
- Video Editing by @Omnirune
